# Alexander Amadeo-Ranch

> Aerospace engineering student at UC Irvine (B.S. in progress; coursework ends March 2027; available for full-time work from April 2027). UAV Hardware Engineering Intern at Boundary Remote Subsurface Solutions (Sep 2026 - present) and Systems Engineer on UCI CubeSat (Mar 2026 - present). Focus: mechanical design, structures and hardware integration.

## Engineering work

- [FlatSat V1 and CubeSat structures](https://alexengineer.net/#/projects/cubesat-structures): bench fixture for up to 12 avionics PCBs; designed, PLA-printed and installed all 14 mounts; total purchase order 30% lower than V0. M3 standoff factor of safety 5 against yield by calculation and simulation (physical vibration testing pending). Ground hardware; nothing has flown.
- [UAV hardware assessment](https://alexengineer.net/#/projects/boundary-uav-assessment): system-level assessment (mass and power budgets, load paths, thrust, propellers, performance envelope) with SOLIDWORKS, ANSYS and COMSOL; delivered two weeks early; informed a change in hardware direction. Findings are under NDA.

## Course and personal projects

- [Autonomous robot](https://alexengineer.net/#/projects/mae-106-autonomous): experimental lead on a four-person MAE 106 team (sensor calibration, duty-cycle and hinge-height sweeps).
- [Mission to Didymos](https://alexengineer.net/#/projects/mae-146-didymos): MATLAB Lambert-transfer search; 20.028 km/s for the assigned dates versus a 7.873 km/s grid minimum. Preliminary course analysis.
- [AeroLab 2D](https://alexengineer.net/aerolab/) and [AeroLab 3D](https://alexengineer.net/aerolab-3d/): browser aerodynamics tools for learning; outputs are estimates.
- Other entries in the work index: recovery-UAV proposal (concept only), lunar ice impact study, PD controller design, EXOHUNT (TESS transit search; unvetted candidates, not discoveries), read-only OBD-II dashboard, vehicle work, coursework.
